description: Records the incoming audio into a loop and freezes it there, so the sound holds instead of moving on

params.text: Sets where in the buffer the frozen loop ends
Sets where in the buffer the frozen loop begins
Crossfades between the incoming sound and the frozen loop
Freezes the loop, and lets the sound run on again when pressed a second time
Chooses whether the start and end knobs are read as a position in the buffer or as a length from one of them
Jumps the balance fully to the frozen loop while it is frozen, whatever the MIX knob says
How likely a clock tick is to freeze or unfreeze the loop, from never to every tick

inputs.text: The left channel of the sound recorded into the buffer
A gate or a trigger here freezes the loop; the menu chooses which of the two it reads
A clock here can freeze and unfreeze the loop, at the odds the chance knob is set to
Sets where the frozen loop ends in place of the END knob
Sets where the frozen loop begins in place of the START knob
The right channel of the sound recorded into the buffer

outputs.text: The left channel, the incoming sound and the frozen loop blended
The right channel, the incoming sound and the frozen loop blended

notes: the buffer holds only what has been recorded from the IN jacks, so a freeze gives silence until audio has been running into them
menu: Buffer Size — sets how many seconds of audio the buffer holds
Freeze mode — chooses how the freeze input is read: Gate freezes while the voltage is high, Toggle on trigger switches the freeze on and off on each trigger

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
